cases.rationale: The crop shows a real road crossing signal with a lit red lamp, barrier machinery and passenger cars down the street. The no-turn sign is not a stop sign. At the right edge a partly occluded passenger transit vehicle has tall windows and doors, but this crop does not resolve bus versus rail tram/train; both 5 and 6 remain unclear. Distant upright shapes by the far sidewalk could include pedestrians but are too small to identify confidently, leaving person unclear. Crossing hardware is not itself a train. I considered each of the 75 definitions; the other vehicle, animal, carried-item, sporting, vessel, food, furniture, appliance and small-object definitions have no identifiable qualifying object here.

Only a printed sign with green lettering and a red cartoon bird wearing a jacket and striped tie is visible. The drawn bird, clothing and tie are excluded depictions, not actual bird, person or necktie objects; the lettering is not a stop sign. After considering every frozen definition, no actual qualifying object in any of the 75 categories is present. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A close-up shows actual metal scissors: opposing arms, the central joint and portions of both large finger loops rest on dark textured material. These are identifiable scissor parts, not a separate knife or unidentified metallic strip. The background material supplies no identifiable chair, couch, bed or bag context. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered; no other qualifying object and no unresolved category ambiguity are visible.

The red octagonal roadside sign clearly reads STOP. Parked passenger cars line the road and a real person is partially visible along the left edge. The large foreground pole and distant street lamps do not show traffic-signal heads. Trees are unpotted, and no carried bag or separate accessory is identifiable on the cropped person. I considered all 75 definitions; the remaining categories have no qualifying visible object. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual red folding pocketknife has a long pointed cutting blade extended to the upper right and a small pair of opened scissors extending toward the lower left. The upright narrow tool is a file, not an additional eating utensil. A ruler and cord are outside the category set. The wooden surface alone does not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no other qualifying category and no unresolved category ambiguity are present.

Several actual elephants fill the foreground, with identifiable thick bodies, ears and trunks; people stand behind the railings by the building. The roof overhangs are fixed building structures rather than umbrellas. Background foliage lacks an identifiable plant-and-pot combination, and the railings and white background shapes do not identify a chair, bench or dining table. Every frozen definition was considered; no other qualifying object is visible and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual people are playing on a fenced red tennis court. The foreground player holds an identifiable oval tennis racket to her left; court and net context support tennis rather than badminton. Balls and the net are not among these 75 categories. Trees are unpotted, and light poles are not traffic lights. I considered each definition, with no other qualifying object or unresolved category ambiguity.

A standalone television sits on a white media cabinet, decorative narrow-neck vases flank it, and gray upholstered couch portions enter along the bottom edge. The television depicts objects that do not count as actual bowls or cups. The equipment at right is stereo/media equipment rather than a microwave or oven; the red foreground surfaces are side tables, not established dining tables. Printed items on the left red table and at the left edge may be books or magazines/booklets, so book remains unclear. No computer keyboard, mouse or integrated laptop is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered; the explicit no list records the remaining absent categories.

A long articulated actual bus with road wheels stands in the covered roadway, and small human figures are visible farther along the platform on the right. The roadway and visible bus construction support bus rather than train. The small partly cropped illuminated dark rectangular assembly at the extreme upper right could be a traffic signal head or an electronic display, but its face is too limited to resolve those categories, leaving traffic light and tv unclear. Overhead fixtures elsewhere are ordinary lighting or printed signs. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered; the remaining categories lack identifiable actual objects.

The entire crop is a printed picture of knitted vegetable-shaped craft objects, with clearly visible yarn stitches and a page fold. The orange carrot forms and green florets are not actual carrot or broccoli food, and the yellow object is not actual apple, orange or banana fruit. The printed wooden surface does not establish a real dining table; the page is not identifiable as a bound book. Each of the 75 definitions was considered and none has an actual qualifying object. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual baseball player stands on the infield with a dark fielding mitt held near his waist, and spectators are visible beyond the advertising wall. The mitt is a baseball fielding glove rather than batting gloves. Advertising text and uniform markings do not count as depicted objects, and the crowded background does not expose an identifiable separate chair or bench. All 75 definitions were considered; the remaining categories have no qualifying object and no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual scissors with paired round finger loops and closed blades stand upright among desk supplies. The mesh cylindrical vessel is a pen holder, not a drinking cup or vase; the narrow green object is a pen, not a bottle or toothbrush. Loose papers, a file folder and cardboard boxes do not identify a bound book or suitcase. This is a work surface rather than a dining table, and the plain vertical background panels do not identify an appliance. Every frozen definition was considered, with no other qualifying category or unresolved category ambiguity.
